CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  August 5, 2024

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  None

  Commissioner Dorado arrived at 7:04 P.M.

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Avery Tao, Planning Technician; Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant;
  Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  EXTENSION FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-40 AND
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-22-17 (7:01 P.M.)
  2834 West Main Street
  Applicant: Ranum Magellan
  • Request: This is a request for a one-year extension for the
  previously approved Planned Development Permit PD-22-40 and
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-17 to construct a 733 square foot
  addition to an existing commercial building and reconfigure a
  parking area in order to accommodate a proposed nursery school
  located at 2834 West Main Street (APN 5292-008-001) and APN
  5292-008-002 (no address), in the CMU (Commercial Mixed-Use)
  zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-14 approving a
  one-year extension to August 18, 2025, for the previously
  approved Planned Development Permit PD-22-40 and
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-17 subject to the Conditions of
  Approval, and finding the one-year extension for Planned
  Development Permit PD-22-40 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-
  22-17 to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301,
  Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations, which
  exempts from CEQA review projects that are existing facilities.

  1
  08/05/2024
 AGENDA
ITEM 3:  EXTENSION FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-55 AND
  CONDITIONAL USE PERIT CUP-23-18 (7:01 P.M.)
  226 West Main Street
  Applicant: Ben Fried
  • Request: This is a request for a one-year extension for the
  previously approved Planned Development Permit PD-23-55 and
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-18 to establish a music school in
  an existing commercial lease space located at 226 West Main
  Street within the CBD (Central Business District) zone and WMC
  (West Main Corridor Master Plan) overlay district.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-15 approving a
  one-year extension to July 28, 2025, for the previously approved
  Planned Development Permit PD-23-55 and Conditional Use
  Permit CUP-23-18 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and
  finding the one-year extension for Planned Development Permit
  PD-23-55 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-18 to be exempt
  from review under the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the
  California Code of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review
  projects that are existing facilities.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Items 2 and 3.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Dorado

AGENDA
ITEM 1:  MINUTES – JUNE 3, 2024 (7:03 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the June 3, 2024, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the June 3, 2024, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Vice President
  Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-4-1
  Ayes:  Gardea, Grijalva, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson
  2
  08/05/2024
   Noes:  None
  Abstain:  Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii
  Absent:  Dorado

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-24-01 (7:03 P.M.)
  • 910 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Reema Jiwani
  • Request: Conditional Use Permit CUP-24-01 is a request to
  amend the Conditions of Approval for Conditional Use Permit CU-
  95-7 to allow an Off-Sale General alcoholic beverage license
  (Type 21), permitting the sale of beer, wine, and distilled spirits for
  consumption off the premises, at an existing grocery store, Asia
  Supermarket, located at 910 West Valley Boulevard in the CMU
  (Commercial Mixed-Use) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-13 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-24-01 amending the Conditions of
  Approval for Conditional Use Permit CU-95-7 subject to the
  Conditions of Approval, and finding Conditional Use Permit CUP-
  24-01 amending the Conditions of Approval for Conditional Use
  Permit CU-95-7 to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301,
  Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations, which
  exempts from CEQA review projects that are existing facilities.
  • Planning Technician Avery Tao provided the Staff presentation.
  • Reema Jiwani, applicant and business owner, was available to
  answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 4.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Pham.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham,
  Tsujii, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  None

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  •  Commissioner Gardea commended Staff on the public hearing item staff report
  and commented on the American Planning Association’s annual conference in the
  fall, which features a Planning Commissioner track. (7:10 P.M.)

  •  President Olson commented on Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) reporting. (7:11
  P.M.)
